login.title: HeyBub
login.subtitle: The simple way to track your baby's daily activities

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Intro: HeyBub collects information you provide directly when using our baby tracking app:

section1Items.accountDesc: Email address and name via Google Sign-In
section1Items.babyDesc: Baby names, birth dates, and gender
section1Items.activityDesc: Feeding, diaper, sleep, and other tracking data you log
section1Items.healthDesc: Doctor visits, vaccinations, medications, and growth data

privacy.section2Intro: We use your data solely to:
section2Items: Display your logged activities and summaries
Enable sharing with caregivers you authorize
Improve app functionality and fix bugs
privacy.section2NoSell: We do not sell your data to third parties.
privacy.section3Intro: Your data is stored securely using:
section3Items: AWS cloud infrastructure with encryption at rest
HTTPS encryption for all data transmission
privacy.section4Intro: We only share your data when:
section4Items: You explicitly share a baby profile with another caregiver
Required by law or legal process
section5Items: Access all your stored data through the app
Delete your baby profiles and associated data
Revoke sharing access at any time
Request account deletion by contacting us
privacy.section6Text: This app is designed for parents/caregivers to track infant care. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.
privacy.section7Text: We may update this policy periodically. We will notify users of significant changes through the app.
privacy.section8Text: For privacy questions or concerns, contact us at:
